content.text: Yinni Gusunɔ, wunɛn miyɑ nɑ kuku yeru kɑsu.
A ku de n sekuru wɑ bɑɑ fiiko.
Wunɛ wi ɑ rɑ siri dee dee,
ɑ mɑn wɔro kpɑ ɑ mɑn fɑɑbɑ ko.
A mɑn swɑɑ dɑkio, kpɑ ɑ mɑn somi.
A de ɑ n sɑ̃ɑ nɛn kpee bɑɑ mi kon kuke.
Kpɑ nɑ n wɑ̃ɑ mi bɑɑdommɑ.
Wunɑ ɑ ɡɔ̃ru doke ɑ mɑn fɑɑbɑ ko.
Domi ɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɛn kuku yeru nɡe kpee bɑɑ dɑmɡiɑ.
Gusunɔ nɛn Yinni, ɑ mɑn wɔro tɔn kɔ̃sobun nɔmɑn di
kɑ nuku kɔ̃suruɡibun nɔmɑn di.
Domi wunɛ sɔɔrɑ nɑ yĩiyɔbu mɔ.
Sɑɑ nɛn piiburun di, wunɑ nɑ nɑɑnɛ sɑ̃ɑ.
Sɑɑ dɔmɑ tèn di bɑ mɑn mɑrɑ, wunɛ sɔɔrɑ nɛn nɑɑnɛ yɑ wɑ̃ɑ.
Wunɑ ɑ mɑɑ mɑn yɑrɑ nɛn mɛron nukurun di.
Wunɑ ko nɑ n siɑrɑmɔ bɑɑdommɑ.
Tɔn dɑbiru tɑ̀ n mɑn wɑ, biti rɑ bu mwɛwɑ.
Adɑmɑ wunɛ, ɑ kuɑ nɛn kuku yee dɑmɡiru.
Yinni Gusunɔ, ɑ de nɑ n nun siɑrɑmɔ bɑɑdommɑ.
A de nɑ n nun bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃ɛmɔ tɔ̃ɔ bɑɑtere.
A ku mɑn deri nɛn tɔkɔru sɔɔ.
A de ɑ n kɑ mɑn wɑ̃ɑ bɑɑ nɑ̀ n dɑm dwiiyɑ.
Domi nɛn yibɛrɛbɑ bɑ nɛn ɡɑri mɔ̀.
Be bɑ kɑsu bu mɑn ɡo, bɑ nɔɔ tiɑ mɔ̀.
Bɑ ɡerumɔ bɑ mɔ̀, wee ɑ mɑn deri.
Bɑ koo mɑn nɑɑ swĩiwɑ bu mwɑ.
Domi nɑ ǹ ɡoo mɔ u mɑn wɔrɑ.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, Gusunɔ nɛn Yinni, ɑ ku mɑn deri.
A nɑ fuuku ɑ mɑn somi.
A de be bɑ kɑsu bu mɑn ɡo mi, bu burisinɑ bu kɑm ko.
A de be bɑ nɛn kɑm kobu kĩ bu sekuru wɑ.
Adɑmɑ nɛ, wunɑ nɑ yĩiyɔ.
Nɑ kon nun siɑrɑmɔwɑ nɑ n dɔɔ.
Kpɑ n wunɛn ɡem kɑ wunɛn fɑɑbɑn ɡɑri kpɑrɑ tɔ̃ɔ bɑɑtere.
Domi yɑ ǹ nɔru mɔ.
Yinni Gusunɔ, kon wunɛn sɔm dɑmɡinun ɡɑri ɡere.
Wunɛ turon ɡem ɡɑriyɑ kon kpɑrɑ.
Gusunɔ, wunɑ ɑ mɑn keu koosiɑ sɑɑ nɛn birun di.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ sere kɑ tɛ̃ nɑ wunɛn sɔm ɡeenun ɡɑri kpɑrɑmɔ.
Gusunɔ, ɑ ku mɑn deri bɑɑ nɑ̀ n tɔkɔ kuɑ,
kpɑ n kpĩ n kɑ tɛ̃n ɑluwɑɑsibɑ
kɑ be bɑ koo rɑ mɑrurɑ wunɛn dɑm ɡɑri sɔ̃.
Wunɛn ɡem mu wɑ̃ɑwɑ sere kɑ wɔllɔ.
Gusunɔ, ɡɑ̃ɑ bɑkɑnɑ ɑ kuɑ.
Wɑrɑ u kɑ nun weenɛ.
Wunɑ ɑ derɑ sɑ wɑhɑlɑ kɑ nuku sɑnkirɑnu wɑ.
Adɑmɑ kɑɑ nɑ ɑ sun wɑ̃ɑru wɛ̃,
kpɑ ɑ sun yɑrɑ sɑɑ siki wɔrun di.
A mɑn nukuru yɛmiɑsio kpɑ ɑ de n nun bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃.
Yinni, kon nun tɔmɑ kɑ mɔrɔku,
kpɑ n nun siɑrɑ kɑ womusu wunɛn bɔrɔkinirun sɔ̃.
Kon wunɛn yĩsiru wɔlle suɑ kɑ mɔrɔku,
wunɛ wi ɑ sɑ̃ɑ Isirelibɑn Yinni Dɛɛro.
Nɑ̀ n nun siɑrɑmɔ, bɑ koo nɛn nuku dobu wɑ nɛn wuswɑɑn di.
Mɛyɑ mɑɑ nɛn hunde ye ɑ wɔrɑ yɑ koo nun tɑkɑru ko.
Mɛyɑ mɑɑ nɛn yɑrɑ yɑ ko n wunɛn ɡɑri kpɑrɑmɔ sɑɑ bɑɑyere.
Be bɑ kɑsu bu mɑn ɡo, bɑ burisinɑ bɑ sekuru wɑ.
